mine.title: My Certificates
mine.subtitle: Certificates you have earned. Each one carries a public link anyone can use to verify it.
mine.emptyHint: Complete a course (and pass its exam, when one is required) to earn your first certificate.

view.notFound: This certificate is not in your list.

verify.title: Certificate verification
verify.validHint: This certificate was issued through TareeqElm and matches our records.
verify.notFoundHint: Check the link or the code printed on the certificate. A certificate that does not appear here was not issued by TareeqElm.
verify.loadFailed: Could not verify this certificate right now. Please try again.

config.title: Certificate
config.description: Trainees receive a certificate automatically when they complete the course. You can also require them to pass one of the course's quizzes first.
config.trackDescription: Trainees receive this track's certificate automatically once they complete every course in it. You can also require a capstone quiz from one of the track's courses.
config.requiresExamHint: The certificate is issued only after the trainee passes the selected quiz (any passing attempt counts; the best score is recorded).
config.noQuizzes: This course has no quizzes yet. Create one first to use it as the exam.
config.noTrackQuizzes: None of this track's courses has a quiz yet.
config.passingScoreHint: The threshold is the quiz's own passing score. To change it, edit the quiz itself.
config.quizRequired: Choose the exam quiz, or turn off the exam requirement, before saving.
config.saveFailed: Could not save the certificate settings

issue.title: Issue academic certificate
issue.description: Award {{name}} an academic certificate. It appears in their certificates immediately and can be verified publicly.
issue.titleHint: Printed on the certificate as the reason it was awarded (2 to 200 characters).
issue.titleInvalid: Enter a title of 2 to 200 characters.
